title: Semiclassical analysis for Yang--Mills random connections on compact surfaces
summary: We introduce anisotropic Banach spaces of distributional 1-forms on compact surfaces designed to capture the fine regularity properties of Morse gauge-fixed Yang--Mills random connections. Using singular connections supported on unstable curves of a Morse gradient flow, we provide a new description of the moduli space of flat connections and of its canonical Atiyah--Bott--Goldman symplectic form. When the group is the special unitary group, we prove that in the zero-area limit, the Yang--Mills random connection converges, within these anisotropic spaces, to a random distributional 1-form…
